meaning: Technology that listens to spoken words and turns them into typed words on the screen.
clues: Spoken words go in, and written words come out.
You use it when you tap the little microphone on your phone's keyboard and talk instead of typing.
It helps people who find typing hard, and it is handy when your hands are busy.
It is also how some apps make captions of what people are saying.
It has three words, with "to" in the middle. The first word starts with S.
assumes: Text to speech reads typed words out loud
Voicemail is a recorded phone message
An audio recording is a saved sound file

decoys.meaning: Technology that reads typed words out loud in a computer voice.
A recorded phone message left for you to listen to later.
A saved sound file of voices, music, or other noises.
